notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: one 2016 map entry (tnlandforms GA141, no source note) and a Wikipedia stub. The name 'lavender mtn' is the map compiler's own label (entries 73 and above are named by the compiler), not a documented tower name. LOCATION CONFLICT, unresolved: the map point 34.33511,-85.24571 is about 7 km (4.4 mi) west of the Wikipedia summit coordinates 34.336,-85.168, and the heights differ (1,534 vs 1,526 ft). Possibly the record location is off; a human should check the point against imagery before publishing. The map gives elevations with no unit; this story reads them as feet, consistent with the record's 467.6 m and Wikipedia's 1,526 ft. No source found says a tower was built, staffed or removed here, and nothing found says whether the summit is accessible or private. Wikipedia's House o' Dreams caption is the only mention of anything on the summit.
